span.p:
1. PRESENTATION TIER
React 19 single-page app, runs in the browser
Pages and layouts: Home, Jobs, Companies, Login, Register, dashboards
Components: modals, Navbar, Sidebar, ProtectedRoute
State and API clients: Redux Toolkit / RTK Query
(authApi, publicApi, applicantApi, companyApi, adminApi)

div.style: color: rgb(11, 28, 48) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
2. APPLICATION TIER
Node.js + Express 5 REST API (base path /api/v1)
Pipeline: CORS, JSON parser, cookie-parser, routes
Security: authMiddleware (JWT cookie), roleMiddleware, multer uploads
Controllers: auth, applicant, company, admin, public jobs
Business logic: validation, OTP, status rules, cascade deletes

div.style: color: rgb(11, 28, 48) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
3. DATA TIER
MongoDB through Mongoose
Models: User, Job, Application
Collections: users, jobs, applications
